argv: tag=; [ ! -f krffs/recovery_authorized_keys ] || tag=-with-key; make -s -j8 rach2 tests krffs test-image utils check-busybox check-dropbearmulti rach2-recovery build/images/rach2-recovery$tag.krffs build/images/rach2-recovery$tag.iso build/images/installer-test.disk build/images/installer-test-mbr.disk build/tools/image/mkmbr build/tools/image/mkgpt build/tools/inspect/growset build/tests/system/harness build/tests/host/mkexfatfixture ARCH=i686 </dev/null && cp ${SRC}/tools/dev/machine_grow.sh ${WORK}/machine_grow.sh
